tweet.text:
Speculative decoding speedups are usually quoted at batch size 1.
At high batch you're already compute bound, so every rejected draft token is wasted FLOPs.
The 3x on the slide can turn into 1.1x in production.
Benchmark it at your real concurrency, not the demo's.
